evidence_quotes.quote: PH 1500 effervescent tube contains 10 tablets (60 g net weight, 6 g per tablet): 1,500 mg sodium, 250 mg potassium, 48 mg calcium, 24 mg magnesium per liter (750 mg Na / 125 mg K / 12 mg Mg per 500 ml tablet).
Per tablet (500 ml serving): 16 kcal (67 kJ), 1.8 g carbohydrates (1.0 g sugars), <0.1 g protein, <0.1 g fat; sweetened with sucralose.
Precision Fuel & Hydration low-calorie effervescent tablets (PH 500, PH 1000, PH 1500) carry NSF Certified for Sport batch testing.

adversarial_checks: Caught per-liter (1,500 mg Na) vs per-tablet (750 mg Na) naming trap and encoded exact per-tablet values (0.875 g Na+K per 6.0 g tablet).
Verified 6.0 g x 10 = 60 g net weight (0.0% deviation) and 0.875 / 6.0 * 100 = 14.58% Na+K purity.
Verified total pure Na+K = 8.75 g (8,750 mg); calories = 16 kcal (<20 kcal effervescent citric-acid base).
Confirmed zero legacy blocklist overlap and SM-05 factual compliance.
